newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to add reserves via 3-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to add reserves via 3-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Monday through system repurchase agreements, analysts said.

"We're looking for a three-day system RP," said Lee Youngdahl, bond market analyst at Aubrey G. Lanston & Co. "It's to replace the four-day system RP that runs out today and there's also a residual add need of $2.0 billion."
The Fed added $1.752 billion in temporary reserves to the banking system through four-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Thursday.
At mid-morning on Monday, Federal funds were trading at 5-7/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate.
